name: MERIDIAN PROSTHETICS MandiblePro HD Jaw
product_name: MERIDIAN PROSTHETICS MandiblePro HD Jaw Replacement
description:
The MandiblePro HD replaces the entire lower mandible with a titanium-ceramic composite frame anchored to the zygomatic and temporal bones via osseointegration posts, with synthetic musculature attachment points that preserve natural bite mechanics. Bite force is enhanced to approximately 800 PSI — roughly four times average human — via reinforced joint geometry and synthetic ligament tensioners. The system includes a full set of ceramic-coated teeth graded for industrial stress, and a concealed hollow cavity within the left rear molar assembly that can store small items up to 8mm diameter, accessible via deliberate tongue-press sequence. The jaw's exterior is matched to patient skin tone and is indistinguishable from organic tissue under casual inspection.

Mandible replacements are most commonly installed following traumatic facial injury, cancer resection, or industrial accidents. The MandiblePro HD is the hospital-default option for jaw replacement across Meridian's public health system, meaning it's widespread enough that nobody looks twice. The hidden molar compartment is technically not listed in the official product documentation — it appears in every unit, a legacy design feature from an older model that Meridian Prosthetics has never bothered to remove, and which the street has thoroughly discovered.
installation_requirements: Maxillofacial surgical team, 5-7 hour procedure, general anesthesia, 3-week soft-food recovery, speech therapy recommended
rejection_risk: Low — Meridian's osseointegration posts use well-established hydroxyapatite coating; primary risk is in patients with compromised jaw bone density
maintenance: Annual dental inspection, joint lubricant injection every 2 years, synthetic ligament tension check
